LESSON: MANNERS OF EATING BY THE END OF THE SUB-STRAND

Grade: Grade 1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: MORAL 6.1.1 Greetings the learner should be able to:  Learners are guided in pa
Topic 6.1.2: Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: what is before you during eating?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. practise Islamic manners of eating as per the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W)
2. appreciate the use of Islamic manners of eating as an act of ibadah.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. practise Islamic manners of eating as per the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W)
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to practise Islamic manners of eating as per the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W). Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the use of Islamic manners of eating as an act of ibadah.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the use of Islamic manners of eating as an act of ibadah. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand.
2. Explain Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand.
4. Show that you can: practise Islamic manners of eating as per the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W)
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Manners of eating By the end of the sub-strand. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: what is before you during eating?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. practise Islamic manners of eating as per the teachings of the Prophet (S.A.W)
2. appreciate the use of Islamic manners of eating as an act of ibadah.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
